theorem_title: Source-control words fit a cubic scale envelope
formal_statement: theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.EncodedColorResources.source_controls_word_le (n : ℕ) : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightSourceControls.word (_root_.ThreeSum.EncodedColorResources.half n) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.EncodedColorResources.blocks n) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.mu n) ≤ 200*(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.EncodedColorResources.scale n)^3 := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For input length $n$, with the actual local size, block count, and total block-size cutoff, $$\operatorname{sourceControlWord}(n)\le200\operatorname{scale}(n)^3.$$

This estimate ensures the computed occurrence count, compact capacity, and bank stride fit the selected-color word budget.
